storage.description: A store of the owner's to keep the tables in. Absent: a place of its own on the deployment's store.

name.description: The warehouse's name in the lake: what an Iceberg client passes as `warehouse`.

WarehouseStorage.description: A place in an S3-compatible object store that is the warehouse's alone. The store must hand out short-lived keys itself (STS, as MinIO and RustFS do): that is how a unit reaches one table's files.

credential.description: The credential the lake uses for the bucket; its secret holds `accessKeyId` and `secretAccessKey`. No computing unit ever gets it: the lake hands a unit short-lived access to the tables it may touch.

endpoint.description: The store's endpoint, as the lake and the computing units reach it. It is the deployment's own store or one an administrator listed in the settings (`warehouseEndpoints`).

keyPrefix.description: A path in the bucket that only this warehouse uses; absent: the whole bucket.

WorkMode.description: How the agent's changes go: `auto`, it makes them once it has started work; `manual`, each one waits for a person's approval.

WorkModeSetting.description: How the agent's changes go in a chat: the chat's choice, else the project's, else the platform's (`auto`).

Workflow.description: The typed envelope, served by the kind routes.

WorkflowLink.description: A link from one operator's output port to another's input port.

WorkflowOperator.description: An operator instance in a workflow.

inputPorts.description: Defaults to one input port input-0 (none for sources).

operatorID.description: Unique within the workflow, e.g. scan or avg.

operatorProperties.description: Property values following the operator type's JSON Schema. A file property takes a dataset file URI, texera://datasets/{rid}@{vno}/files/{path}.

operatorType.description: A built-in operator type, e.g. CSVFileScan, or the URI of a custom operator with `@vno`.

outputPorts.description: Defaults to one output port output-0.

viewResult.description: Store this operator's output so it can be read after the execution.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

WorkflowPort.description: A port of an operator in a workflow.

defaultComputingUnit.description: The computing unit an execution uses when the request names none.

defaultWarehouse.description: The warehouse an execution keeps its results in when the request names none.

layout.description: Where each operator's card sits on the canvas, by operator. It is the app's: nothing that runs the workflow reads it, a move alone makes no version, a version keeps the places it was made with, and an operator with no place is placed beside what it connects to. A spec written without it keeps the places of the operators it kept.

WorkflowValidation.description: A dry run: the engine's compile result and the plan the catalog would start an execution with.

operatorOutputSchemas.description: Output schemas per operator id and output port id.

WorkflowVersion.description: A version with typed content, served by the kind routes.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.
